prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Water Treatment Utility, Company Size: 340 employees, Pain Points: Effluent exceedances 3 times this year, chemical storage not compliant with SDS requirements, no environmental objectives tracking, community complaints about odor

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore": "Low", "gaps": "The water treatment utility faces several critical gaps: frequent effluent exceedances indicating ineffective process control and monitoring, non-compliant chemical storage lacking proper SDS management, absence of formal environmental objectives and tracking mechanisms, and community odor complaints suggesting insufficient emissions control and community engagement strategies.", "recommendations": "Implement real-time effluent monitoring systems and conduct root-cause analysis for exceedances. Upgrade chemical storage facilities to meet SDS requirements and establish a centralized SDS management system. Develop and enforce environmental objectives with regular tracking and reporting. Install odor control technologies and implement a community engagement plan to address concerns proactively. Initiate ISO 14001 implementation for environmental management and consider ISO 45001 for occupational health and safety.", "standards": "ISO 14001 (Environmental Management Systems), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 9001 (Quality Management Systems)"}
